title: Mass player churn at specific game level (Difficulty Cliff / Churn Spike)
symptoms: Sudden drop-off spike in level completion funnel analytics
causes: Introducing an unexplained game mechanic without proper tutorial
Exponential difficulty jump in enemy health or puzzle complexity

solution.action: Inspect attempt count and failure ratios for the churned level in analytics.
Smooth difficulty curve and provide dynamic hints after repeated failures.
A/B test tuned level configurations via Remote Config.

prevention: Set up granular funnel telemetry for the first 15 levels prior to launch.
